name: ProofOfDeliveryExceptionDesk
tagline: Review every POD, catch over / short / damaged deliveries and close them with the customer informed – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete OS&D desk for carriers, 3PLs and shippers: POD review queue with signature, piece counts, notation and photos; automatic short / over / damage detection; raise-exception rules for photos and concealed damage; exception board from open to closed with owner, root cause, resolution and a supervisor approval threshold; customer notification from a template; POD-missing, notification and resolution clocks; KPIs, CSV and summary outputs for flows. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Short / over / damage detected from piece counts
Owner, root cause, resolution, supervisor approval threshold
Customer notification template → Power Fx / Outlook
POD missing, notification and resolution clocks
Bulk accept, assign, notify, close + undo
Keyboard review (J/K/A/E/R), phone layout with bottom bar
ExceptionCsv and SummaryJson for Teams / email / Power BI flows
Demo mode with fictional sample data
